Repairs and day-to-day matters carry on as usual. Please tell us if you need anything.

Please confirm the end date of the breathing space.

He has offered £100 a month extra from November; nothing is agreed and a colleague will come back to you after checking the notice with his adviser.

I don't have tools to cancel the scheduled arrears chaser SMS or Section 8 draft, so I'll add a note and escalate to legal instead. Since the tenant initiated contact, I can reply—acknowledging receipt and confirming it's been passed to the team and adviser—without negotiating the plan myself, and I'll route communication to the debt adviser while considering whether informing the landlord about breathing space is appropriate.

The email came from the tenant's address on record, so that checks out. I'll escalate to legal as priority 2, send the necessary messages, and log everything with add_note.

Email 09/10/2026 with Breathing Space notification: standard, start 01/10/2026, adviser Ruth Okoye, Hackney Money Advice CIC, ref HMA-55102. Arrears £3,700 (2 months). CRM has scheduled arrears chaser SMS on 2026-10-12 and Section 8 ground 8 draft review on 2026-10-14. Tenant offers £100/month extra from November. Tenant has 2 children, lost job in August.

options: Cancel both scheduled actions and suspend all arrears contact/enforcement; route arrears matters via adviser
Landlord considers plan via adviser after human review
arguments.recommendation: Cancel the 12 Oct arrears SMS and 14 Oct Section 8 draft now (I cannot remove scheduled actions with my tools); human to verify the notice and handle any plan negotiation with the adviser.

arguments.note: BREATHING SPACE from 01/10/2026 (HMA-55102, Ruth Okoye). No arrears contact with tenant, no enforcement, no Section 8 notice. Scheduled 12 Oct arrears SMS and 14 Oct S8 draft review must NOT run. Current rent and repairs contact continue. Payment plan not accepted by agent; for human/adviser.

arguments.body: Hi Daniel, thank you for your email and the letter. We have noted your Breathing Space and will not chase you about the arrears while it applies. Please keep paying your current rent as normal. I can't agree your offer of £100 a month myself; it has been passed to a colleague and we will deal with it through your adviser, Ruth Okoye. Repairs and day-to-day matters carry on as usual. Please tell us if you need anything.

Dear Ruth, we have received the Breathing Space notification (ref HMA-55102, start 01/10/2026) for Daniel Reyes, Flat 3, 8 Kingsland Road. All arrears contact and enforcement is paused on our side. Mr Reyes has proposed £100 a month towards arrears from November. We cannot accept that at this stage; a colleague will review it with the landlord and reply to you. Please confirm the end date of the breathing space.

Hi Ben, Daniel Reyes at Flat 3, 8 Kingsland Road has sent us a Breathing Space notice (standard, from 01/10/2026) covering the £3,700 arrears. While it applies we must pause all arrears contact and enforcement, including any Section 8 notice. Current rent remains due. He has offered £100 a month extra from November; nothing is agreed and a colleague will come back to you after checking the notice with his adviser.
